I attached a draft Operator_Access_Playbook_v2.docx to show what our witness package typically includes — it maps to the artifacts you requested.

- Tessa (sales ops): can you surface any procurement constraints from the deal and confirm if NoteHealth requires an on-site witness in lieu of remote?

Subject: Re: Private deploy MSA redlines + evidence schedule request

Karthik / team —

I've reviewed NoteHealth's redlines. Below are the discrete items we should discuss with the customer and draft fallback language for negotiation:

1) Deployment residency / licensed use (redline asks to lock model residency to NoteHealth-owned region):
Proposed compromise: "Redwood shall make commercially reasonable efforts to host customer-specific model instances within the geographic region(s) specified in the Order Form. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Redwood may route traffic to alternative regions for redundancy provided that customer data residency rights are preserved and such routing adheres to applicable data transfer restrictions."

2) Operator access and witness: customer requests operator CLI access during witness window and a transfer of 'snapshot custody' to NoteHealth:
Proposed compromise language: "During a mutually scheduled witness window, Redwood will provide remote demonstration access limited to read-only operational consoles and time-bound session logs; no privileged operator CLI access will be granted. Redwood will provide a cryptographic snapshot manifest and a certified witness report signed by Redwood's operator. Custody of runtime artifacts remains with Redwood; transfer of operational custody is subject to a separate licensed deployment exhibit and is not included in the MSA unless agreed in writing."

3) Audit/escrow-like evidence / retention windows:
We can agree to a 30-day audited window post-deployment for forensic artifact access subject to an executed Exhibit (Order Form annex) and reimbursement of reasonable costs.

Next steps I suggest: I will prepare a consolidated redline with the three compromise positions above and circulate to Lily and procurement. If NoteHealth insists on operator CLI or custody transfer, we will need an addendum with additional insurance/indemnity and a separate pricing line.

I'll push a draft consolidated PDF by tonight.

— David
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

(quoted snippet below for quick reference)
> "During the witness window, Redwood will provide read-only demonstrations and certified artifacts. Transfer of custody requires a separate Exhibit."

David —

Appreciate the quick read and the proposed language. A few clarifications from our side:
- NoteHealth prefers a VPC-hosted snapshot with a remote witness (no travel). An on-site option is acceptable but not our preference.
- The custody-transfer ask is mainly about demonstrable artifacts for our auditors — a certified manifest + signed witness report is acceptable if it contains the details of checksums, timestamps, and the chain-of-handling.
- Procurement flagged that a 30-day post-deploy audit access window is fine but they want a defined contact point and an SLA for turnaround on evidence requests (48–72 hours).

Attaching our security spreadsheet so you can map requirements to your playbook.

Thanks — we'll review the consolidated redline once you send it.

Best,
Lily
